header: One to four rings, drawn with CSS
lead: Each ring fills to the number you type, so enter 72% rather than three quarters. No chart library and no SVG are involved.
note: The percentage appears as text in the centre of each ring. Without the drawing, the band still says the same thing.

metrics.title: A full ring
metrics.text: Values above 100 stop at a closed circle.

metrics.title: A partial ring
metrics.text: The fill starts at the top and runs clockwise.

metrics.title: Another partial ring
metrics.text: Leave the value empty and the ring stays empty, never full.
